description: This file generates a salary payments report based on payment modes, including data retrieval, processing, and chart generation.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table based on payment modes.

methods.name: get_payment_modes
methods.description: Retrieves distinct payment modes from Salary Slip records.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares branch-wise data and total gross pay from salary entries.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches salary data, processes totals, and prepares report summary.

methods.name: get_total_based_on_mode_of_payment
methods.description: Calculates total amounts per payment mode across all data.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Generates a summary of gross pay, deductions, and net pay with indicators.

methods.name: get_chart
methods.description: Creates a bar chart visualization for payment modes.
